content:
A small change can sometimes make a big difference. This is especially true for users with large libraries of pre-loaded beta software, thanks to Apple's latest TestFlight update.

Apple has just updated TestFlight for iPhone, iPad, Mac and more. The new version 4.3 adds a search bar for quickly finding apps.

A quick comparison with version 4.2.2 shows the difference immediately: TestFlight now features a search bar at the bottom on iPhone and at the top of the sidebar on Mac.

If you only have a few pre-loaded beta apps, this might seem like a basic change, but for users with extensive catalogs of beta apps, the search functionality is a long-awaited update.

This update also displays more apps in the "Previously Tested" category, so the usual bug fixes and performance improvements may be related to this.

Apple's TestFlight app is available on the App Store for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro and Apple TV.
